name: The TOADALNAEC and the Three Lies
title: We Are the Toads: A Free Mask, a Gold Handshake, a New Toad Carried Through the Ship, a Speaker Who Would Not Show His Hands, and a Duel Nobody Saw Finished
date: 1 Aethel, 1040 BF — the afternoon after the town shop (estimated; the account carries no clock)
timeWindow: 1 Aethel, 1040 BF, afternoon after the town shop (estimated from the account's sequence). The source gives no clock reading; the earlier 15:00 code was more precise than its evidence. This event is on the Material Plane aboard the Vigilance/TOADALNAEC.
location: The town beneath the Legionlance, then the gangway and the hall of the old Vigilance, now the Toads' TOADALNAEC (Material)
status: Filed — the ship is the Toads', Speaker L is in a Toad cell, Rivers is on fire, the hall is walking out, and the duel has not ended
summary: Remi is handed a free mask and walks up the gangway of the old Vigilance with the party's toads, where a gate toad insists the ship is the Toads' TOADALNAEC and sends for Hudston, whom Remi turns gold with a handshake. The toads sing Remi through the ship as the new toad, and Speaker Rivers receives the party in a hall: he has taken over Speaker L's post, Speaker L is in a cell, and the Toads recite the three lies of Archie Miser. Markop demands to see Rivers' hands, casts a truth spell on a crowd, hears a toad say he stole something from Archie, and duels Rivers while the crowd walks out.
description:
Waluigi opens this filing with the shortest line in it, sung by the party's toads on the walk up to the ship: **"We are the toads."** It is the song that took Remi to the front door of [the old Vigilance](#/article/vigilance), and the song that was sung to carry her through the rest of it.

The Legion's ship is not the Legion's anymore. It belongs to the Liberated Toads, or to a Speaker who says it does, and he has taken over a job that the party thought was still held by a toad now in a cell on a lower deck. He has a tea service, a crowd and a lesson plan, and the lesson is that Archie Miser is a liar, a madman and a man who put Toads back in their place. By the end of the afternoon the lesson has been put to a hall of toads, to a barrel, and to a centaur with a spellbook.
outcome: The Toads hold the old Vigilance, which they call the TOADALNAEC, and Speaker Rivers holds the Toads. Speaker L is in a cell. Dan has been told to report to Rivers and not to the Pond Patrol. Archie is in a barrel and Green T has the barrel. Remi has turned a handful of toads gold. Markop has challenged Rivers, forced a look at his hands, cast a truth spell that Rivers refused to acknowledge, set Rivers alight, and is left in a hall whose crowd has started to leave.
notableFeatures: A free mask from a shopkeeper who underpays on everything else
A ship with two names and one layout
A toad who goes gold on a handshake and asks to be shot
A song that carries a recruit through the ship
The three lies of Archie Miser, recited by the people he saved
'Get away from me, you filth animal. Surround her. Oh, oopsie.'
A speaker with his hands in his pockets
A truth spell that worked on the wrong toad
A duel conducted with a pen and a battleaxe

participants.name: Remi Akamatsu
participants.role: Took the free mask and refused to wear it, shook Hudston's hand and turned him gold, was carried through the ship as the new toad, offered Rivers a high five, and turned a row of toads gold by leaning on them.

participants.name: Markop
participants.role: Challenged Rivers to a duel, dodged a trapdoor, called the takeover a coup, demanded Rivers' hands, cast a truth spell on a crowd, and set Rivers on fire.

participants.name: Archie Archbold Miser
participants.role: Walked into the hall to be named an arsonist, fell into a barrel, asked from it why the Toads he saved hate him.

participants.name: Dan
participants.role: Asked whether the toads around the party were theirs, said he was independent, and was told to report to Rivers.

participants.name: Green T
participants.role: Followed the party to supervise, shot at Hudston to test the gold, and pulled Archie's barrel back.

participants.name: Speaker Rivers
participants.role: Received the party as recruits, claimed Speaker L's post and Disaster Inc., dodged a high five, hid his hands, drank tea through a truth spell, and was set on fire in a duel.

participants.name: Hudston
participants.role: Came out on call, asked Remi whether she was gold or gold-plated, went gold on a handshake, and was shot to prove it.

participants.name: Gentlepad
participants.role: Crossed the hall to remove 'Archie germs' from Markop.

participants.name: Speaker L
participants.role: Named, not seen: in a cell on the ship by Rivers' account.

reputationNotes.markop: Called the Toads' command a coup in front of the Toads and asked them whether a speaker who would not show his hands had earned their trust. The crowd was still walking out of the hall when the account ended.
reputationNotes.archie_miser: Named by the Toads in the hall as an arsonist and a liar. The people who hold that view are the ones he says he saved.
reputationNotes._record: Nothing else moved. The Toads' regard for the Legion was not tested, and the ship's new name is the Toads' own.

aftermath:
**The ship is the Toads'.** [the old Vigilance](#/article/vigilance) carries a Toad name, and the gate the party tried to claim was held without a sign of the Legion.

**Speaker Rivers holds the Toads.** He took Speaker L's job, he says, while the party handled the manor, and the party has been told to report to him. Rodger is named; the Pond Patrol is not.

**Speaker L is in a Toad cell.** The Legion arrested him, the Toads say they got him back, and they put him in jail.

**Archie is in a barrel.** Green T has pulled it back. The Toads still hold that he is an arsonist and a liar.

**A toad was silenced mid-sentence.** He said he stole something from Archie and was sent to the dungeon with tea in his mouth.

**The duel is open.** Rivers is burning. Markop is ready for another strike. The hall is leaving.

**The mask is on Remi's sheet.** Nobody has put it on.
waluigiAssessment:
**1. The ship changed hands, and the argument about it never changed.** The gate toad's case was that the layout was the same. The party's case was that the ship was theirs. The archive files the afternoon as two sets of people who both thought they owned the old Vigilance, and the only thing that settled it at the gangway was a song.

**2. The mask is the only thing that was free, and the only thing that was gold.** Remi was handed a mask, refused to wear it, and within the hour was turning Toads gold with a touch. The account puts them in the same afternoon and says nothing connecting them. The archive does the same and wants it on the record that it noticed.

**3. Rivers showed the floor.** He claimed to have killed with his bare hands, was asked for his hands, and held up dirt. The Toads took a metaphor for chains. Whatever he did, the account does not file him in a fight.

**4. The third lie covers the first two.** 'Anything Archie says is a lie' means nobody has to check the other two. A crowd that has been taught that does not need to look at a village.

**5. The truth spell worked, and was stopped with a teapot.** A toad in range said he stole something from Archie. Rivers answered with the tea. The archive is waiting for the dungeon to say what it was.

gallery.caption: Remi among the gold toads, and Speaker Rivers above them with his tea.

sections.name: I. For Free
sections.overview:
The gold bar was gone, and the coins it had been turned into were in a pocket, and [Remi](#/article/remi_akamatsu_full_backstory) was in the mood to spend the rest of the afternoon on something other than a shop.

"Now that I sold money to that guy," she said, "we can go on an adventure."

The shopkeeper, the same one who had paid a third of what the bar was worth, came out from behind the counter. "I have an adventure mask for you," he said, "and it's free."

"For free?" Remi said. "It does sound interesting. For free."

He put it in her hands. It was gloomy. She looked at it for as long as it took to decide. "I won't wear it," she said. "Maybe the toads will."

Then she and the others went out of the door. [Green T](#/article/green_t) went after them. "I'd better supervise them," he said.

The toads in the party sang as they walked, and the song was short:

**"We are the toads."**

*WAH! A counter that pays a third gives away a mask. The archive has priced a great many free things and would like it noted that the shop only ever gave anything away after it had finished taking.*
sections.waluigi_note: Nothing in the account says what the mask does, who it was made for, or why a shopkeeper who offers a third on everything lets a gloomy one go for nothing. The archive has the mask on the sheet and has not been told what it is. WAH.

sections.name: II. Whose Airship
sections.overview:
[the old Vigilance](#/article/vigilance) was where they had left it, and the gangway had a toad on it.

"Who goes there?" the toad said.

"Us," said the party. "The owners of the airship."

"That's not right," the toad said.

"What do you mean it's ours?"

"No, no, no, no. This is the TOADS' airship. The TOADALNAEC. It belongs to [Speaker Rivers](#/article/speaker_rivers)."

"No, no, it may be the same layout," came the answer, "but I assure you it's ours."

The toad on the gangway looked at them, and then over his shoulder, and then he made the decision of every gate guard in every archive: he sent for someone else. "Come on out, Hudston," he called. "We have a problem."

*WAH! The Legion renamed this ship and got it wrong. The Toads have renamed it back and got it wronger. TOADALNAEC. Waluigi has said it forty times to himself and has not yet found where the stress goes.*
sections.waluigi_note: The ship on the gangway is the Vigilance. Both sides in the argument say the layout is the same, because it is. Neither side, at any point in the account, says the other is wrong about the layout. Only about whose it is.

sections.name: III. Gold or Gold-Plated
sections.overview:
[Hudston](#/article/hudston) came out on deck and stopped when he saw [Remi](#/article/remi_akamatsu_full_backstory).

"Wow," he said. "Are you gold, or gold-plated?"

"Come and find out for yourself," said Remi, and she shook his hand.

The gold started at the palm. It ran up his arm and across his shoulders and out to his feet, and when it had stopped he looked at himself for a moment and turned to the gangway.

"Hey, guys," Hudston said. "Check it out. I'm gold now."

"You want to test it out?" Remi asked.

[Green T](#/article/green_t) told him to stand against the wall, and Hudston stood against the wall, and Green T shot him. The bullet rang off the gold and went somewhere else.

"Wow," Hudston said. "How can I ever repay you? It kind of stung, but it's really fun."

Green T shot again, with the same result.

The other toads on the gangway said the sentence the afternoon was about to be built on.

**"You're one of the toads now."**
sections.waluigi_note: The account does not say that the mask caused the gold. It does not say that the mask didn't. It says a girl was handed a thing for free, would not put it on, and was shaking hands with metal within the hour. The archive is not going to settle that and would like the room to stop looking at Waluigi.

sections.name: IV. The New Toad
sections.overview:
Remi started singing. It was not a good song, and she did not stop.

*Oh, I'm the new toad, listen to me, I'll sing a song in the air or the sea,* she sang, and the toads sang it back.

They picked her up. The new toad, the crowd sang, will be **very small, nimble and happy.** "What a fun game," they said. "We will see."

They carried her through the ship, singing, all the way along.

*Oh, I'm a new toad, listen to me, I'll sing you a song, the air and the sea.*

Behind them, the others had worked out what they were looking at. The toads from Disaster Inc. went after Remi to try to save the rest of the party, and caught up with the song in time to see the toads set Remi down.
sections.waluigi_note: Waluigi would like the record to show that nobody sang her a lullaby by accident. The verse is a recruitment drive with a tune, and the tune worked on a girl who had been given a mask for free an hour earlier. It has been a day.

sections.name: V. Speaker Rivers Receives
sections.overview:
[Speaker Rivers](#/article/speaker_rivers) came out into the hall like a man arriving at his own party.

"Oh, good," he said. "New recruits."

The hall was full of toads, and the party was in the middle of them. "You guys with our toads," [Dan](#/article/dan_the_toad) asked, "or...?"

"They're with me," said Speaker Rivers.

He looked at the party for a moment and nodded to himself. "Hmm. I don't know. So you're the Liberated Toads, right?"

"I feel kind of independent," Dan said. "I got back with Rodger. Is anyone here from the Pond Patrol? I have to report to them."

"Oh, don't worry about them," said Rivers. "You report to me now. I took over Speaker L's job while you were handling the whole manor situation."

Then [Archie](#/article/archie_miser) walked into the hall, and everybody saw him.

**"IT'S HIM! THE MAN WHO BREATHES FIRE! ARREST HIM FOR CRIMES AGAINST THE TOADS!"**

"What's going on here?" Archie asked. [Markop](#/article/markop) had already taken a step forward.

"Is this legal?" he asked. "The Legion arrested [Speaker L](#/article/speaker_l)."

"No," said a toad. "We got him back. And we put him in jail."

"Isn't this a coup d'état?" Markop said. "Let me duel you. You're unfit to rule."

"Fine," said Speaker Rivers.

*WAH! Speaker L was arrested by the Legion, rescued by the Toads and put in a Toad cell by the rescuers. That is a single sentence, and everybody in the room said it with a straight face.*
sections.waluigi_note: Rivers took Speaker L's job 'while you guys handled the whole manor situation.' The 'manor situation' is the party's whole last month, and Rivers uses the phrase the way a man uses it who was not at the manor. The archive has no date for when Speaker L's post changed hands and nobody in the hall offered one.

sections.name: VI. The Three Lies
sections.overview:
Markop walked out onto the floor to meet him and dodged a trapdoor on the way. Archie fell into a barrel. The account does not say how.

"I saved you from slavery!" Archie said from inside it.

The toads picked up the barrel. It went up on shoulders. Markop started to argue with them and was told that Archie was an arsonist, and Markop said they had been saved by him, and Archie Miser fell into a barrel, which the account says twice, so the archive does too.

[Gentlepad](#/article/toad_gentlepad) came up to Markop. "Stand still," Gentlepad said, "while we get these Archie germs off of you."

"What have they been telling you?" Archie asked from the barrel.

"The three lies of Archie Miser," the toads told him, and they took him through them one at a time, each with its correction.

**"1. He saved the toads."** "No. He didn't save them. He put them back in their place, to be cogs in the machine."

**"2. Archie Miser is a sane individual."** "False. Archie Miser is INSANE. He burnt down a village full of orphans."

"That ain't true," Archie said. "I do have flaws, but the village never happened. On remembering it was someone else."

**"3. Anything Archie says is a lie."**

"That's it," a toad said. "Those are the three Miserly principles."

"Okay," Markop said, "so if that was true, why isn't he fireballing us right now?"

"Because he's scared of me," said Speaker Rivers.

"Archie fought an evil tree," said Markop.

*WAH! Three lies, recited by toads, ending in the fact that the third one covers the first two. The archive would call it a logical trick if the ship were not holding the logician in a barrel.*
sections.waluigi_note: The second lie is a charge of burning a village of orphans, and Archie answers that the village never happened and that he remembers it being someone else. The archive has nothing to put under either half of that. It files the charge and the reply side by side and declines to pick.

sections.name: VII. Why
sections.overview:
From the barrel, Archie spoke to Rivers, and it was the longest thing he said all day.

"This is the first time I've met you," he said. "You don't scare me at all. If I wanted to, I would do what Markop did. But I'm nice, and so I need to understand why you hate me. I saved you guys, all hundred and fifty of you. So why?"

Nobody in the hall answered it. "Well," Archie said, "take it away, Remi."

[Remi](#/article/remi_akamatsu_full_backstory) had been listening with her head on one side. "I'm not sure why Archie is evil," she said, "but why not?"

She went for a high five, up high. [Speaker Rivers](#/article/speaker_rivers) dodged it.

"Get away from me, you filth animal!" he said, and then, to the toads, "Surround her. Oh, oopsie."

He had caught himself. It was too late. The whole hall of toads said the same thing together.

**"Huh?"**

"You guys want to be called that?" Markop asked, into the quiet. The toads paused, and the pause went round the hall.

*WAH! A recruiter's slip is the one thing a crowd always hears, and Rivers had just told his own followers what he called them when he thought they weren't listening. Waluigi has been bitten by that dog before.*
sections.waluigi_note: 'All hundred and fifty of you' is Archie's number, given from a barrel. The archive has no other count and files this one as his.

sections.name: VIII. Show Me Your Hands
sections.overview:
Markop turned to the hall.

"Did anyone actually see Speaker Rivers fight?"

"Yeah," Rivers said. "I fought. Killed them with my bare hands." He put his hands in his pockets.

"Let me see your hands," said Markop. "They should be bruised and bloodied."

The hands stayed where they were. "Out of your pockets," Markop said. Rivers made a fake stumble and tripped on the floor, and when he came up he held both hands out.

"See?" he said. "My hands are dirty. Dirt and dust."

"I said bruised and bloodied," said Markop. "See? He's lying to you."

"I personally unchained you guys," said Rivers, "and freed you."

Markop asked the hall whether anyone remembered being unchained by Rivers.

"The metaphorical chains," Rivers said.

"Makes sense," said a toad.

"Wasn't Speaker L the savior?" Markop asked.

"No," said Rivers. "He was a vigilante criminal."

Markop was about to say something, and then he saw [Green T](#/article/green_t) on the far side of the room, pulling the barrel back. He gave him a look. Green T nodded back.

Over by the wall, [Remi](#/article/remi_akamatsu_full_backstory) spun round to watch. Another toad had turned gold.
sections.waluigi_note: The hands are the whole case. A toad who says he killed with them has to show them, and Rivers was asked for his hands and produced the floor. The chains turned out to be metaphorical, and the Toads took that without a murmur.

sections.name: IX. Tea, and the Truth Spell
sections.overview:
[Speaker Rivers](#/article/speaker_rivers) said he was a bit too tired and asked whether anyone could carry him, and the toads carried him.

"Your tea's ready, sir," one of them said, and he drank it.

"That's not a potion, is it?" Markop asked.

"No, no. Just tea."

Markop looked down at his spellbook and smiled. "We don't have to fight," he said. "You just have to tell the truth, and I'll go. I have a spell that will make it so you can't lie. I ask you questions."

[Remi](#/article/remi_akamatsu_full_backstory) had gotten bored. She leaned on a toad, and the toad went gold. She yawned and hit another, and he went gold. She kicked her legs back, and a third.

The tea came. Rivers sipped.

"Of course," he said, "I'd never lie to anyone."

Markop pointed at him. "Now say the truth spell didn't work."

"Maybe you're a bad magician," said Rivers.

Markop lost his temper. "You want me to beam you?"

"No," Rivers said, quickly.

Markop turned to the toad next to him, who was in range of the spell. "Tell me your secret."

"I like lifting up people," the toad said, "and I also stole something from Archi—"

Rivers forced the tea down the toad's throat, and the toad threw up.

"Hey," said Markop. "What did he steal?"

"Into the dungeon with him," said Speaker Rivers. They dragged the toad away. He drank another one, a blue one this time, a coffee.

*WAH! A speaker accused of lying asked for his tea and then used it to stop another man talking. The account has the whole interrogation in two cups.*
sections.waluigi_note: The toad was inside the spell and the spell did not misfire. It said a true thing, and a second later someone silenced the speaker with the contents of a teapot. Whatever the toad stole from Archie is not on file, because the end of the sentence is a tea cup.

sections.name: X. The Pen and the Axe
sections.overview:
Markop turned back to Rivers. "You're lying. We need to duel. The spell clearly didn't work."

"I am the best," said Speaker Rivers. "It's not a lie."

Archie was still in his barrel.

Rivers attacked Markop with a pen. The pen, he said, is mightier than the sword.

They duelled. Markop attacked and set Rivers on fire, and Rivers screamed. The battleaxe swung and set him on fire again, and he screamed again. Another swing missed. Someone grabbed for the battleaxe and was too weak to take it.

Then the toads began to walk away.

"Lame," some of them said as they went. "He's losing his crowd."

Markop smiled, and got ready for another strike. The account ends there.
sections.waluigi_note: The account never says whose hands the burning battleaxe was in, or which man was too weak to take it. The archive files the hall emptying out as the only clear outcome of the fight. WAH.

name: The Intake Drone and the Unfinished Escape
title: The Intake Drone, the Blackout, and the Escape That Did Not Finish
date: 1 Aethel, 1040 BF — continuation aboard the TOADALNAEC after the afternoon takeover; no clock or elapsed interval is recorded
timeWindow: A same-day continuation of the 1 Aethel TOADALNAEC account. The scene remains aboard the ship after the takeover, but neither a clock time nor an interval between the two accounts is stated. The archive does not place it past midnight.
location: Aboard the old Vigilance, now the TOADALNAEC (Material Plane), including the engine room and interior passages
status: Filed — Eager is released after questioning; Remi escapes the intake drone by cutting power to the ship's field, then fights the Toads and ends surrounded but invisible, feeling along a wall. Archie leaves after attempting to stabilize Perot. The escape, Perot's condition, and the ship's power state remain unresolved.
imageCaption: The engine room is dark after Remi removes X.O.'s staff. Masked Toads search for the escaped prisoner; Remi has gone invisible, but the wall ahead has not yet become an exit.
image_alt: In a dark airship engine passage, an almost invisible red-haired girl with a staff is surrounded by masked Toad guards with colored caps; a barrel lies nearby, and a small spell-light catches the searchers' masks.
summary: Aboard the TOADALNAEC, Remi offers a porcupine Toad a high five before the Toads demand the stolen technology and trap her inside an intake drone. Eager is questioned about the missing Pond Patrol and released; Salam explains that he was separated from Rodger and Toad Lee. The drone carries Remi to the engine room, where the Toads say her power will drain over a week and set Perot to watch her. Remi removes X.O.'s staff from the field and the ship's power immediately fails. In the darkness she shoots Perot, escapes during the search, and reunites with Archie as he crawls out of a barrel. Archie later treats Perot instead of fleeing with Remi. Lulu Green and other Toads block her route; a fight leaves Remi surrounded, blinded, and invisible, still searching along a wall when the record ends.
description:
The last filing left the old Vigilance in Toad hands, a hall in uproar, and Archie inside a barrel. This one stays aboard the same ship. It does not begin with a new map or a clean report of the duel's end. It begins with Remi trying to pick up where she left off.

She offers a high five to a porcupine Toad. Then the Toads demand the stolen technology. An intake drone opens, takes her in, and shuts its bars. Eager is brought over to answer questions about the Pond Patrol. He says he was sent without a detachment, went on a misadventure that took longer than expected, and believes Toad Lee and Rodger were sent too. He cannot say where either is. Salam is there; the whereabouts of the other two remain unknown. Eager is told his answer is sufficient and that he is free. Remi is not. The Toads say she trespassed and turned people gold.

They carry the drone to the engine room. There, an unnamed Toad explains that the field will drain Remi's power over a week, with Perot assigned to overwatch. Remi wonders whether the ship has taken off. She takes X.O.'s staff out of the field. The power immediately goes out.

The blackout does not end the confinement. It changes the room in which the search begins. Remi casts light, finds the assembled Toad Rangers, presses her musket to a Toad's head and fires. The bullet bounces off the Toad's squishy body; the Toad falls bleeding. The other Toads run with Archie's barrel. Remi disguises herself and moves with an escort, while the barrel is carried toward an electrical port it was not meant to enter. Archie is shocked, stays silent, then crawls out through the bottom.

The ship keeps making claims about who owns it, who betrayed whom, and which prisoners deserve a way out. Remi and Archie do not agree on what to do. Archie chooses to help the Toad she shot. Remi stays. The fight grows from one bleeding guard to a masked search party, and the filing stops while she is still trying to find a way around a wall. WAH.
outcome: Eager is released after questioning. Remi gets out of the intake drone when she removes X.O.'s staff from the engine-room field, causing the ship's power to fail; whether the vessel itself stops, lands, or remains in flight is not recorded. Perot is shot and left bleeding, and Archie attempts to stabilize him, but the result is unknown. Archie leaves through a doorway while Remi remains in conflict with Lulu Green and other Toads. Their fight is unfinished: Remi ends surrounded, unable to see, and invisible, feeling for a route around a wall. The status of the missing Pond Patrol members, the intake drone, the staff, and the ship's systems is unresolved.
notableFeatures: Remi's attempted high five to a porcupine Toad is interrupted by a demand for stolen technology; the result of the high five is not recorded.
The intake drone closes its bars around Remi; Eager answers the Toads' questions and is released.
Eager says he was sent without a detachment and cannot locate Rodger or Toad Lee; the Toads' claim that the Pond Patrol has been missing three weeks is not independently verified.
Salam says he failed the mission and became separated from Rodger and Toad Lee; the Toads invoke his past association with Speaker L.
Perot is assigned to overwatch Remi in a field that is said to drain her power over a week.
Remi removes X.O.'s staff from the field; the ship's power immediately goes out, but the record does not say whether the ship stops moving.
Remi's bullet bounces off the Toad she shoots; he falls bleeding and is later identified by Lulu Green as Perot. Archie makes an uncertain attempt to stabilize him.
Archie escapes the barrel after it is carried toward an electrical port and shocked; the Toads' account of Speaker Rivers and Speaker L is relayed during the disguise walk.
Lulu Green pardons Archie but calls Remi the Toads' number-one target; he leaves while she stays behind.
Remi is blinded and surrounded by masked Toads who can see in the dark. She turns invisible and chooses to go around a solid wall; no exit is shown.

reputationNotes._record: No numerical reputation changes are filed. Remi's shooting of Perot and her designation as a target are clear; the record does not provide a score or show the whole faction's response. Archie's attempt to aid Perot and Lulu Green's pardon are preserved as actions, not converted into invented standings.

aftermath:
**The blackout is real; the ship's motion is not on the record.** Remi removed X.O.'s staff from the field and the power went out. Nobody establishes whether the TOADALNAEC was still flying, had stopped, or had begun a descent.

**The detention changed hands but did not end.** Eager was questioned and released. Remi remained confined, then escaped the intake drone. Her later escape from the ship is not recorded.

**The Pond Patrol report is a report.** The interrogators said the Patrol had been missing three weeks. Eager said he was sent without a detachment and could not locate Rodger or Toad Lee; Salam also said he had become separated from them. The archive has no independent confirmation that either is missing, where they were sent, or what happened during the interval.

**Perot is wounded; the outcome is unknown.** Remi shot him. Archie tried to stabilize him and did not know whether it worked. No death is recorded.

**Archie left. Remi did not.** Lulu Green pardoned Archie and made Remi the Toads' primary target. Archie passed through a doorway; Remi remained inside the fight.

**The final position is unresolved.** Remi is blinded, surrounded by masked Toads, and invisible. She feels a wall and chooses to go around it. The article ends before she finds a door, a ladder, or an exit. WAH.
waluigiAssessment:
**1. A release from questioning is not a release from the ship.** Eager gets a welcome aboard after explaining that he came without a detachment and cannot find his companions. Remi gets told that she is being held because she trespassed and turned people gold. The distinction the Toads draw is visible. The basis for that distinction is not fully stated.

**2. The missing Pond Patrol is a claim with a witness attached, not a solved disappearance.** Eager does not locate Rodger or Toad Lee; Salam says he was separated from them. That is enough to put the names back on the page. It is not enough to say who sent them, what the mission was, or whether the Toads' three-week figure is true.

**3. The staff was the switch the room had built around.** The Toads explained a week-long drain, set Perot to watch, and put Remi in the field. Remi removed X.O.'s staff and the ship's power went out at once. The record supports that chain; it does not support a claim that the ship stopped flying.

**4. Remi and Archie made opposite choices at Perot.** Remi fired at him; Archie tried to keep him alive. Lulu pardoned Archie and named Remi the target. This is not a clean moral contrast: Archie had been carried in a barrel and shocked, Remi had been confined and was trying to escape, and Perot is still one of the people who stood guard over her. The record leaves the conflict where the choices made it.

**5. 'Our ship' has become the question under every door.** Remi says the Toads took their ship. Archie answers that it is technically the Toads' ship and tries to respect their way of life, then says that way is wrong. Nobody settles the history in the passage. The last filing established who holds the Vigilance; this one shows that possession has not made its passengers agree about ownership.

**6. The dark does not belong to the invisible person.** The Toads have masks that let them see in the blackout. Remi makes herself invisible and assumes the trick works both ways: if she cannot see them, they cannot see her. The tactic is a thought, not a confirmed escape. She feels a wall and goes around. Waluigi will not call that safe, free, or finished. WAH.

**Recommendation:** find out whether Perot lived, whether the engine room can be restored without X.O.'s staff, and where Rodger and Toad Lee were sent. Do not call Remi out of danger until the next filing actually gets her out.

gallery.alt: In a dark airship engine passage, an almost invisible red-haired girl with a staff is surrounded by masked Toad guards with colored caps; a barrel lies nearby, and a small spell-light catches the searchers' masks.
gallery.caption: The power is out, the guards have masks for the dark, and Remi has not found the exit.

sections.name: I. The High Five That Did Not Become a Record
sections.overview:
The ship is still the TOADALNAEC. Remi is still among its Toads. She seems to be turning people gold by touch when the account picks her up again.

“Okay… let’s see, where was I?” she says. Then: “Hey, porcupine Toad. High five.”

The notes do not say whether their hands meet. They move instead to a demand: “Bring out the stolen technology.” The Toads do not identify the object, name the person they believe stole it, or explain why Remi is the one being held to answer. The article begins with that mismatch: a young visitor in the middle of an unfinished gold-touching episode, and a command issued as though the case had already been decided.

An intake drone opens. Remi sees something shiny inside and wonders, “I wonder if there is a person in there.” Then it sucks her in. The bars close. The notes give no chance to finish the question, no account of who is inside, and no explanation for why this machine is the Toads' first answer to a demand for technology. Whatever the drone's intended function, the immediate one is clear enough: Remi is trapped inside it. She is no longer offering a hand to a Toad; she is on the inside of a machine that has brought its own cell bars.
sections.waluigi_note: A high five is not a confession. The demand for stolen technology may be justified, mistaken, or aimed at someone else; the room does not explain. The drone does not wait for the explanation to arrive.

sections.name: II. Eager's Answer and the Missing Detachment
sections.overview:
The Toads drag Eager over to the drone. They tell him to speak the truth and promise they will not let the intake drone become an “outtake drone.” Their question is about the Pond Patrol, which they say has been missing for three weeks.

Eager answers with what he knows. “I was sent without a detachment.” The expedition turned into a misadventure and took longer than expected. He believes Toad Lee and Rodger were sent over; he does not know where either one is. Salam is here, he says. Then Eager repeats the important part: Rodger and Toad Lee look M.I.A.

The interrogators call the answer sufficient. “You are free to go. Welcome aboard.” Eager sighs. The account does not give the questioners' names, the mission's destination, or the evidence for the three-week figure. It does give us a witness who cannot locate two leaders and a third Toad who has returned from a different misadventure. That is a lead, not a search result. The Toads have accepted Eager's limit; the archive must keep it too.
sections.waluigi_note: Eager was sent without a detachment; now he is being asked to account for a detachment he never had. The answer can be sufficient for the room and still leave the archive with the harder question.

sections.name: III. Salam's Designation and the Cell That Moves
sections.overview:
The Toads turn from Eager to Salam. They address him with a designation the notes render as “Alpha Zeta Beta” and say they heard he worked for the traitor Speaker L. They claim Speaker L was cast away down to the “bowels of the earth.” Salam asks, “You did? What happened to him?” The answer is that the same thing will happen to Remi.

Salam says he failed the mission and became separated from Rodger and Toad Lee's detachment. The account does not establish what the designation means, whether Salam's past service was voluntary, or whether the Toads' statement about Speaker L is literal, figurative, or a threat built from an allegation. The ship has already turned one leader's name into a dispute over who holds the command. Here, another Toad is made to answer for the same missing pair.

The drone begins moving toward the engine room. Remi's cell is mobile, but her destination is not freedom. It is the place where the Toads have arranged the next restraint. The question about Speaker L hangs where it was asked: unanswered by evidence, answered only by a threat about what will happen to Remi.
sections.waluigi_note: “Alpha Zeta Beta” is what the notes give us. Waluigi will not convert it into a rank, unit, or identity without a key. The threat against Speaker L is a threat; the account does not make it a verified account of his location.

sections.name: IV. The Field, Perot, and the Staff
sections.overview:
In the engine room, the Toads put Remi in a field associated with X.O.'s staff. A Toad explains that “this will drain your power over time.” Perot is assigned to overwatch her; Remi's power, the Toad says, will drain after a week. The notes do not establish whether this is a field the staff produces, a field the ship supplies, or a separate device built around it.

Remi looks at the engine room and wonders to herself: “Did we even take off yet?” The record does not answer. She reaches for X.O.'s staff and removes it. The power immediately goes out.

That is the confirmed sequence: the staff was in the engine-room field; Remi took it out; the power failed. The ship's engines, flight, and landing are not described after the blackout. The power loss is not a guaranteed crash. It is the moment the prison stops behaving like a lit room and starts behaving like a ship full of people who cannot all see one another. Perot was set to watch a prisoner who still had a way to change the room around him.
sections.waluigi_note: A week-long drain became a blackout in one move. The report says the power went out, not that the ship fell. Waluigi is keeping the difference between a dark engine room and a crashed airship, because the latter has not happened on the page.

sections.name: V. The First Shot in the Dark
sections.overview:
Remi casts a light spell. She sees Toads moving through the dark. The Toad Rangers assemble and call for a search for an escaped prisoner. Remi goes directly up to a Toad and presses her musket against his head. He turns toward her.

“You prisoner.”

Remi fires. The bullet bounces off his squishy body. He falls bleeding. “You shouldn't have locked me up like that,” she says. Then: “This is our ship now.”

The record does not name the Toad until later, when Lulu Green points to Perot and accuses Remi of shooting him. That later identification connects the shot and the injury, but it does not tell us how badly Perot was hurt. The other Toads panic. They grab the barrel holding Archie and run, apparently evacuating him while the search and the power outage overlap. Nobody states where they intend to take him.

The first attack does not settle the argument about the ship. It does make Remi's freedom attempt visible to the people who were supposed to keep watch. Her light spell reveals the searchers; the musket tells them where she is. The account leaves the Toads in motion with Archie still in his barrel.
sections.waluigi_note: The bullet bounces. The Toad bleeds. Those are both in the account; neither cancels the other. Perot's later condition is not reported, and the archive will not turn a shot into a death because the room has not.

sections.name: VI. The Barrel at the Electric Port
sections.overview:
Remi disguises herself and walks with an escort. The notes do not say what the disguise is or which Toads believe her to be one of them. They talk as they move. Remi asks who Speaker Rivers was. The answer: he overthrew Speaker L, rules with his heart rather than his fist, and was the savior.

Remi asks about the person in the barrel. The reply is that he started fires, may have freed the Toads from tyranny, and betrayed them. It is a view of Archie delivered by people who have taken him in a barrel and are carrying him through the ship. The barrel reaches an electric port it was not meant to enter. Archie is shocked. He stays quiet, then crawls out through the bottom.

A Toad sees sparks and Remi with the staff and warns her: “Wait, that's the staff. Remi, no, that's the staff, don't—” Someone grabs Remi by the head. She bonks him. She is dragged away; the notes say that contact turns a Toad gold. “You forgot I am made of gold,” she says. Archie tackles a Toad with a gun. In the blackout, the barrel has failed as a container, the disguise has failed to end the pursuit, and the arguments about Rivers and Speaker L have become part of the same route as the escape.
sections.waluigi_note: The barrel was not meant for the port. Archie was not meant to be carried through an electrical connection. The notes are less clear about the disguise, the grab, and the gold-touch sequence; those uncertainties stay attached to the scene.

sections.name: VII. Archie Finds Remi; Remi Leaves Archie
sections.overview:
Archie says he cannot see well in the dark. Remi tells him she is right above him. He chooses left instead. She identifies what is happening: she was kidnapped, and the only way to escape was to cut power to the whole ship. Archie objects to the scale of that answer: “Wait, you what?” Remi is dragged away again.

The Toads sing, “We are the Toads who will kick your ass.” Archie bumps into a wall. Remi stabs his arm with her dagger; the account does not explain the purpose or result of the wound. Then Archie hears Remi screaming and calls her name, repeating it as he follows. He says Eager, Salam, and Remi will not like the consequences.

The reply is that the only way out was to cut the power, and that Remi's friend will understand. Archie says, “We will talk later.” He wants to reach an inn and get their bearings. “It pains me we have to leave our friends here,” he says, coughing as he looks at the Toad. His plan is not agreement with Remi. It is a temporary route away from the immediate fight, and the account lets the two of them keep disagreeing while they move.
sections.waluigi_note: The singing is a line, not a complete song. The dagger's purpose is not supplied. Archie can be angry about the blackout and still follow; Remi can be trying to escape and still leave him behind. The record has room for all three facts.

sections.name: VIII. Perot and the Pardon
sections.overview:
Lulu Green stops them with vines. Archie asks to get off the ship and find their bearings. Remi says Lulu is “just plants” and that plants are flammable. Archie asks to be allowed to pass, calling the confrontation a huge misunderstanding. Lulu points to Perot: did he want trouble? Remi shot him.

Remi answers that the Toads wanted trouble when they took the ship. “You Toads are all the same,” she says. Lulu asks for a duel. Remi fires her crossbow. Archie tells her not to kill anyone while she is fighting blind. Remi asks, “If they're liberated, why are they evil?” Archie says they have trust issues. He uses magic to light his staff, and for a moment he can see Remi and the person with the arrow.

Archie sees Perot about to die. He stops trying to leave and tries to stabilize him. He does not know whether he succeeded. “I did the best I could,” he says, trusting that Perot has a faction to look after him. Then Archie leaves. Lulu says his crimes are small enough that she will pardon him, though she will speak to the higher-ups later. Remi, she says, is now target number one. “This isn't just for me anymore. It's for the Toads.”
sections.waluigi_note: Archie spends the opening asking to leave and the ending treating the man Remi shot. He does not know if the treatment worked. The kindness counts; it is not a medical outcome. Lulu's pardon counts; it is not a verdict on Remi.

sections.name: IX. Stone, Lightning, and the Masks
sections.overview:
Archie watches from the doorway. Lulu's skin hardens into stone. “Now we're even,” she says, smiling. Remi rushes her and casts lightning. It passes through Lulu's stone skin. Lulu is shocked and calls herself “crispy.” The exchange does not end the fight.

Zesty Black appears. A giant cross appears over Remi's head, and he says he has found a new target. Vines poke and prod Remi. The plants open a pit in the floor; she dodges it. Black fires two bullets; she dodges those too. Remi grabs Rhelmon's Anchor and hits Lulu over the head. Lulu becomes dizzy. The notes give the object's name but no description, owner, or later custody, so this filing does not register it as Remi's property.

The argument about the ship continues under the attacks. Archie asks Remi not to be racist. He says the Toads are scared, as she is now. “They took our ship,” Remi says. Archie answers that it is technically their ship and that he is trying to respect the Toads and their way of life. Remi says, “Their way of life is wrong.” Yellow dodges the next thunderbolt. Pink blasts color into Remi's eyes. A thunderclap follows; Remi says she cannot see and needs to unblind herself.
sections.waluigi_note: Lulu goes stone; Remi's lightning goes through it; the fight keeps going. A target mark, a pit, two dodged bullets, an anchor-shaped strike, and a blinding color attack all arrive before the ownership argument can finish.

sections.name: X. Around the Wall
sections.overview:
The Toads surround Remi. They have masks that let them see in the dark; they smile and celebrate. Remi thinks for a while. “It's not over yet,” she decides. She turns invisible. “If I can't see them, I can't see me,” she reasons.

She moves by touch. Her hand finds a solid wall. She can climb it or go around it. She chooses to go around.

That is the last recorded action. No one says she clears the wall, reaches a door, or gets off the ship. No one says the Toads catch her. The search has not ended, the ship's power has not been reported restored, Perot's outcome remains unknown, and Rodger and Toad Lee have not been found. Remi is still moving. The wall is still there. The file closes on the choice, not on the escape. WAH.
sections.waluigi_note: Invisible is not the same as unseen when the searchers have night masks. Around is a direction, not an exit. Waluigi is leaving this account exactly where the record leaves it: Remi still moving, and not yet free. WAH.
